exposure: proton pump inhibitor (PPI) exposure (duration, cumulative dose)
personal or family history of atopy
cohort: The study included children with esophageal atresia (EA), with 46 cases who developed EoE matched to 76 controls with only EA.
finding: Prolonged duration and high cumulative dose of PPI exposure, as well as food allergy, family history of atopy, and infantile antibiotic exposure, were significantly associated with an increased risk of developing EoE in children with EA.
